close_reason: Closed as disproven/superseded. The historical observation reproduces, but the remaining defect does not. A 574-fixture comparison found predicate was the only inventory increase after kdt.63; fz-kdt.106/dee588b95 removed that input-row-budget collapse. The unchanged return-widening corpus gate then covered 577 historical fixtures and all 597 origin/main fixtures with zero real return-widening engagements; every activation stayed at <=5 return changes against budget 8. Rebase is already the sound signal that derived content may be invalid, while ActivationInputs remains cumulative, so the proposed separate non-monotone-input trigger does not exist and would undermine ascent convergence. Focused rebase, widening-honesty, inventory, causality, and budget tests all pass at a3a9761d1. Attribution: fz-kdt.106/dee588b95, the fz-rh2.22 return-honesty guard, and fz-kdt.132. File a fresh ticket if a current reproducer crosses the return-widening budget.
description:
Found by fz-kdt.63's adversarial review via canonical-form comparison
(base vs commit, all 574 fixtures): removing the analysis's
retract-and-remint churn moved the emitted inventory on 6 fixtures, in
BOTH directions -- the churn's rebased AnalyzeActivation completions had
been the sole reset of two accumulations.

INSTANCE REPAIRED BY fz-kdt.106 (a010532e8, 2026-09-01): the
enum_predicate_search WIDENING half (207 -> 221; fourteen extra
activations keyed on int | :false | :ok | :true) was the INPUT-side
accumulation -- superseded ascent-history rows tripping the row-budget
collapse -- and dominance absorption removes it principled-ly (the churn
had been accidental replace semantics). Predicate now emits 203 under
BOTH schedules, byte-identical canon; the wide cone is gone. Do not
re-derive that half here.

WHAT REMAINS THIS TICKET'S: the RETURN-side ladder.
ActivationMap::define_return (semantic.rs) replaces evidence and resets
slot.ascents ONLY when rebased -- rebasing is the sole narrowing path
for return evidence and the sole reset of RETURN_WIDENING_BUDGET. With
the churn gone the join-only ascent runs unchecked on some programs;
larger inputs sit closer to the convergence_class/any widening cliff.
Fix direction unchanged: an EXPLICIT reset tied to what actually
invalidates the count (the activation's input evidence moving
non-monotonically), not to retraction accidents. Re-measure the
remaining 5 fixtures' movement on the post-106 base before scoping.
title: Return-widening ladder resets only on rebase: narrowing depended on retraction churn
